segments.text: Your Sun in Gemini, the Brihat Jataka holds, makes a person
learned in grammar, will be an Astrologer and will be rich.
With Mercury in Taurus, the book says you
will be a preacher, will have many sons and [partners], will ever be engaged in earning money, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.
being a minister and will live in comfort.
The translator's notes add that with Virgo rising you would be
inclined to deeds of virtue, will not earn much, and will be skilled in work.
For your Surya-Guru Yoga, the translator's notes say you would be
earnest in work, will be a favorite with [someone with standing] and rich.

sources.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Gemini will be learned in grammar, will be an Astrologer and will be rich.
A person born with Mercury in sign Taurus or Libra will be a preacher, will have many sons and wives, will ever be engaged in earning money, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.
A person born with Jupiter in sign Gemini or Virgo will have many clothes, houses, servants, sons and friends, will be a minister and will live in comfort.
[A person born when the rising sign is Virgo] will be inclined to deeds of virtue, will not earn much, and will be skilled in work.
(4). The Sun and Jupiter, he will be earnest in work, will be a favorite with the king and rich.
